basis: CPI item weights are calculated primarily from average household consumption expenditures obtained from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES). Evidence: "The weight is mainly calculated from the average monthly expenditure by item per household in 2019 and 2020, which is obtained from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES) (Fundamental Statistical Survey based on the Statistics Act)"

Japan's Balance of Payments related statistics are compiled in accordance with the sixth edition of the IMF Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6). Evidence: "Japan's BOP related statistics are compiled in accordance with the sixth edition of the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6) published by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in 2008."

The Korean System of National Accounts compiled by the Bank of Korea follows the 2008 System of National Accounts (SNA) as its analytical framework and compilation standard. Evidence: "Analytical framework: The compilation standard follows the 2008 System of National Accounts (SNA). The Bank of Korea (BOK) completed the transition from the fixed weighted method to the chained weighted method in March, 2009."

Statistics Korea has adopted the COICOP classification for the CPI (12 major groups aligned with COICOP). Evidence: "Recently, the KOSTAT has adopted the COICOP classification. The CPI has 12 major groups: Food and non-alcoholic beverages ... The classification and sectorization used in the compilation of the CPI are in broad conformity with the 1993 SNA, COICOP, and the ILO’s CPI Manual guidelines."

CPI weights are derived from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (or related household expenditure survey results). Evidence: "Sources of weights: The weights are derived from the 2020 Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted by Statistics Korea."

Korea's Balance of Payments statistics are compiled consistently with the IMF's Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th edition (BPM6). Evidence: "The concepts and definitions of the Korea's BOP statistics are broadly consistent with the IMF's Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th edition (BPM6)."

Japan's Input-Output Tables are positioned within the System of National Accounts framework and are compiled with reference to SNA recommendations on concepts, definitions and classifications. Evidence: "The 2008 United Nation recommendations for SNA which needs to comply with the concepts, definitions, etc. of the Input-Output tables classifications"

Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP) estimation follows the conceptual framework of the System of National Accounts, including 2008 SNA recommendations on treatment of R&D and military equipment as fixed capital. Evidence: "단, 상품개발을 위한 연구개발비와 정부가 구입하는 군사장비는 2008SNA 권고에 따라 고정자본"

Definitions of employment, unemployment and labour underutilization in the Labour Force Survey follow the resolutions of the International Conferences of Labour Statisticians (ICLS), including the 1982 resolution and the 2013 resolution on labour underutilization. Evidence: "これらの考え方は，国際労働機関（ILO）の1982 年の第13 回国際労働統計家会議（ICLS）における決議に基づいている。... 2013 年の第19 回国際労働統計家会議（ICLS）における決議では，「未活用労働」という新たな概念が取り入れられ"

The Flow of Funds Accounts are compiled in accordance with the international standard for the System of National Accounts; the series was aligned with 2008 SNA recommendations in conjunction with the national-accounts benchmark revision. Evidence: "The FFA are compiled in accordance with the international standard for the System of National Accounts and are conducive to international comparisons of financial structures. ... The FFA will be revised once again in the first half of 2016 with the implementation of the new statistical standard (2008SNA)."

Weights for the Index of Industrial Production (and related mining/manufacturing indicators) are derived from value-added data in the Economic Census (National Business Survey / Census of Establishments) and related annual surveys. Evidence: "Sources of weights: The weights for the base year were calculated for each industry and item based on the total added value of mining, manufacturing, electricity and gas in that year. The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP)."

Industrial Production Index weights also incorporate Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP) value-added data for the base year and subsequent updates. Evidence: "The data used here was taken from the 2020 Economic Census, the 2020 Annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and 2020 Gross Regional Domestic Product(GRDP). The weights after the base year have been calculated for each industry and item using the annual Mining and Manufacturing Survey and GRDP."

Imputed rent weights and certain structure-related elements of the CPI draw on the National Survey of Family Income, Consumption and Wealth (in addition to the Family Income and Expenditure Survey). Evidence: "In the actual index calculation, the imputed rent, estimated by the National Survey of Family Income, Consumption and Wealth (a fundamental statistical survey based on the Statistics Act)"

The Economically Active Population Survey sample is selected based on the results of the Population and Housing Census and is refreshed periodically from the census frame. Evidence: "The sample is selected based on the results of annual Population and household Census and is used for 3 years."

Item prices used in the CPI are obtained principally from the Retail Price Survey (Trend Survey), a Fundamental Statistical Survey under the Statistics Act. Evidence: "指数品目の価格には、原則として小売物価統計調査（統計法に基づく基幹統計調査）の動向編によって得られた市町村別、品目別の小売価格を用いる"

The Labour Force Survey sampling frame is based on enumeration districts of the Population Census; population benchmarks for estimation also draw on census-derived population estimates. Evidence: "Sample design and frame: The sampling method is a stratified two-stage sampling using the EDs of the Population Census as the first-stage sampling-units... The estimation method for the monthly figures of whole Japan is the ratio estimation with a benchmark of the population by age... estimated from the Population Census and other sources."
